description: Daily price history per GPU class and source, up to 90 days: the rows the Rent Index and the 30-day range are computed from. Marketplace days (Vast.ai, Clore.ai) are medians over the day's counted hourly medians with min, p75 and offer count; list-price days (RunPod, AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud, Lambda, Nebius, CoreWeave, Hyperstack) carry the posted price. Each row says which kind it is; never blend the two. Describes what prices did; it never forecasts.

days.description: Days back from today (default 30, max 365; the series starts 26 August 2026).

gpu.description: One class by slug or name, e.g. rtx-4090, h100. Every class without it.

source.description: One source key, e.g. vast, runpod, aws. Every published source without it.

name: price_history
title: GPU rental price history
